title: Mesoporous Mo-doped NiCo2O4 nanocrystals for enhanced electrochemical kinetics in high-performance lithium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13552-13560
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00918A, Paper

Zahid Abbas, Tanveer Hussain Bokhari, Zohaib Rana, Saman Ijaz, Eman Gul, Amina Zafar, Saqib Javaid, Maria Gul, Khan Maaz, Shafqat Karim, Guolei Xiang, Mashkoor Ahmad, Amjad Nisar
Mo-doped NiCo2O4 nanocrystals enhance electrochemical performance as lithium-ion battery anode. Mo incorporation introduces abundant active sites, high porosity, and structural defects, facilitating rapid Li+ transport and improved cycling stability.
